title: Sita Ramachandraswamy Temple, Bhadrachalam
scope: The Bhadrachalam hilltop main temple precinct in the verified February 2024 exterior views, including the carved north entry tower and sanctuary crown, the slope retaining walls, covered approach and immediate attached temple roofs. The separate wedding hall and other outlying shrines are outside the model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Government census identifies a stone temple on a small hillock with a tall entrance gopura and sanctuary vimana.
State’s March 2026 report identifies start of expansion of temple, environs and ghats.
Describes the historic compound, sanctuary, vimana and chakra.

limitations: The visuals represent 20 February 2024, before the public redevelopment launched in 2026. The dated model is withheld from the default modern map.
The ground comes from unchanged Terrarium elevations. Steps and the upper terraces are modeled from the visible forms, with widths, placement and levels estimated.

Roof records are supporting geometry. Tower base positions, facade and carved motifs, material colors and roof sections are estimates. Later construction, separate major wedding hall and the temple interior are outside scope.
